title: Test launcher: a fresh git worktree without ui/node_modules fails as a raw runner ENOENT; name the missing install instead
outcome: Run test-2e26a3fa (worktree TermAl-wt-kimi, 2026-09-26): the full gate failed before any stage with 'runner: ENOENT: no such file or directory, stat ...\\TermAl-wt-kimi\\ui\\node_modules\\typescript\\bin\\tsc'. Cause (confirmed): a new git worktree has no ui/node_modules (untracked); package-lock identical to main. Fixed by 'npm ci' in the worktree's ui/. Classification: environment (worktree setup), not product/test. Improvement: the launcher's preflight should detect a missing ui/node_modules (or missing native tool) and report 'UI dependencies are not installed in <root>/ui; run npm ci there' as a clear runner error, without installing anything itself (the launcher never installs). Related worktree hygiene: tm-nrmy.
disposal_reason: Backlog triage w-930e4d333f07 (Architect1 body comparison b80d766c; applied by Termal::Fable2): duplicate. Missing ui/node_modules preflight; covered by w-f39fd2916d7a.
